evidence.note: host-primitive rows are the SDK stub's UA surface, not product paint; they are reported separately and excluded.

claims.claim: No clipped text and no horizontal overflow at 100%/200% text, 1280 and 460 CSS px.

evidence.note: the walk presses Tab until every control the DOM declares has been visited once and focus wraps, then counts distinct authored stops; the audio player's UA shadow parts are host-widget stops and are counted separately, never as Coursebook controls.

claims.claim: Every instructional image has a text equivalent.

evidence.note: the shipped module paints no CSS transition or animation in any mode, so the reduced preference removes nothing; the preference is still read and recorded. This claim is trivially satisfied, not proven by suppression of real motion.

claims.claim: Forced-colors mode stays readable and does not depend on the token layer.
